body: The wound lives in self-worth and resources; you may chase or distrust money and struggle to feel you deserve.
business: You help others build security and value themselves accurately.
shadow: Equating your worth with what you have, in either direction.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
